- We'll need a sample of logging/retention artifacts and a pointer to where we can pull any pre-filled CAIQ if available.
- Confirm encryption-at-rest and KMS approach for customer data (high level is fine for kickoff).

Availability window: Tues/Wed morning PT or Thurs afternoon PT. We can do 30 minutes.

I've copied our procurement lead (Sabrina) and our security inbox.

- Tue 2026-06-15 09:00–09:30 PT
- Tue 2026-06-15 10:30–11:00 PT

Marissa (CS lead) and Kimberly (Security) are joining to cover evidence routing and logs respectively.

I attached a draft CAIQ prefill and a 1-page pre-call checklist. If you prefer a different slot than the candidates above, let us know and we'll adjust.
